timeline.body:
Closes gh-32028

### Motivation
- On #32028 , we found that `DefaultRestClientBuilder.defaultRequest(...)` doesn't do anything
  - Cause `RestClientBuilder.build()` doesn't pass `defaultRequest` to `RestClient`

### Modification
- Fix `RestClient` to use defaultRequest on `RestClient.Builder`

### Result
- Now `RestClient` uses `defaultRequest` that passed from `RestClientBuilder.build()` well

https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/blob/faba044735ad173d96b4b1adab62752b48b2c758/spring-webflux/src/main/java/org/springframework/web/reactive/function/client/DefaultWebClient.java#L481-L484

FYI) almost same usage of `defaultRequest` on `WebClient`~!
